summary: AstroNex is an integrated software platform designed to monitor and support astronauts' physical health and psychological well-being during space missions. Spaceflight causes severe challenges such as sleep disruption, high stress, and fatigue. AstroNex addresses this by providing a centralized dashboard that tracks vital signs, visualizes health trends, triggers automated anomaly alerts, and generates comprehensive medical reports. It uniquely combines physical tracking with mental health tools, including calming Earth sounds and relaxation schedules. Utilizing mission datasets from NASA OSDR and PhysioNet, our project is vital because it ensures astronauts stay healthy, focused, and resilient far from Earth, successfully bridging physical care with mental support in one seamless tool
details:
How it works: AstroNex is an integrated software platform featuring a centralized dashboard designed to monitor and support astronauts' physical health and psychological well-being during space missions. It processes and tracks vital signs, visualizes health trends with real-time graphs, triggers automated anomaly alerts, and generates comprehensive medical reports.

Benefits & Impact: The platform addresses critical spaceflight challenges such as sleep disruption, high stress, and fatigue. Its primary impact is ensuring that astronauts stay healthy, focused, and resilient far from Earth by bridging physical care with mental support in one seamless tool

Tools, Technologies & Data Sources: Developed using modern programming and design documentation workflows, including Figma for UI/UX prototyping. It utilizes official mission datasets and benchmarks, specifically the NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR) (such as Inspiration4 datasets) and PhysioNet

Creative Aspect: The unique integration of physical health monitoring with dedicated mental health tools such as calming Earth ambient sounds, custom relaxation schedules, and a specialized three-sound alarm system all within a single accessible dashboard.

Team Considerations: The team carefully structured responsibilities across UI/UX design, data analysis, psychology integration, and research to ensure technical accuracy, seamless user experience, and full compliance with mission guidelines.
